segment.source: Back in m'day the wat'r tashted a lot bett'r 'n' di'n' shmell so 'ardcore.<end>
segment.target: Back in m'day the wat'r tashted a lot bett'r 'n' di'n' shmell so 'ardcore.<end>

segment.source: I gotsh one tooth left. The can op'ner. ::Grins toothlessy.::<end>
segment.target: I gotsh one tooth left. The can op'ner. ::Grins toothlessy.::<end>

segment.source: Grimy's the only fam'ly I gotsh left. My shon.<end>
segment.target: Grimy's the only fam'ly I gotsh left. My shon.<end>

segment.source: Ring Wyrm - fing shirm. Back in m'day we 'ad wat'r shnakes the shize o' shipsh!<end>
segment.target: Ring Wyrm - fing shirm. Back in m'day we 'ad wat'r shnakes the shize o' shipsh!<end>

segment.source: If Biocorp wuz shtill 'round we'd 'ave more channelsh t' watch.<end>
segment.target: If Biocorp wuz shtill 'round we'd 'ave more channelsh t' watch.<end>

segment.source: Back in m'day we 'ad much bett'r barrelsh fer the shoup. Theez kidsh don' even know whatta prop'r barrel tashtesh like!<end>
segment.target: Back in m'day we 'ad much bett'r barrelsh fer the shoup. Theez kidsh don' even know whatta prop'r barrel tashtesh like!<end>

segment.source: Biocorp took care of ush: Ya could shet up bed near any dumpsht'r ya liked! <end>
segment.target: Biocorp took care of ush: Ya could shet up bed near any dumpsht'r ya liked! <end>

segment.source: Back in m'day I could go ta store 'n' buy a toothbrush, shome pashte, shome anti-depresshantsh, an 'air lotion, a pair of shoesh 'n' a bottle of rootka - all fer a shingle shtygian coin.<end>
segment.target: Back in m'day I could go ta store 'n' buy a toothbrush, shome pashte, shome anti-depresshantsh, an 'air lotion, a pair of shoesh 'n' a bottle of rootka - all fer a shingle shtygian coin.<end>

segment.source: I don't need no und'rwear. I alwaysh go 'ardcore.<end>
segment.target: I don't need no und'rwear. I alwaysh go 'ardcore.<end>

segment.source: Back in m'day if ya got drunk ash assh, ya could take a shob'rin' pill. Now ya gotta deal witha hangov'rsh.<end>
segment.target: Back in m'day if ya got drunk ash assh, ya could take a shob'rin' pill. Now ya gotta deal witha hangov'rsh.<end>

segment.source: The Follygarchy can shuck my grind'r, the pipew'rk'rsh.<end>
segment.target: The Follygarchy can shuck my grind'r, the pipew'rk'rsh.<end>

segment.source: The only gewd thin' nowadaysh ish the Arena, 'n' even that wuz bett'r in m'day.<end>
segment.target: The only gewd thin' nowadaysh ish the Arena, 'n' even that wuz bett'r in m'day.<end>

segment.source: Back in m'day the Tunn'lersh shtay'd belo'.<end>
segment.target: Back in m'day the Tunn'lersh shtay'd belo'.<end>
